name: Termites
description: Learn to distinguish between Western drywood termites living in structural rafters and subterranean termites building soil mud tubes along foundation stems.

name: Rodents & Roof Rats
description: Understand the climbing biology and wire-gnawing behaviors of coastal roof rats and mice infesting Huntington Beach attics and sub-floors.

name: Argentine Ants
description: Discover why multi-queen Argentine ant colonies establish massive underground networks across Orange County and how weather drives home invasions.

name: Cockroaches
description: Examine the distinct breeding habitats of German cockroaches in indoor kitchens versus moisture-seeking Oriental cockroaches around sewer ties.

name: Bed Bugs
description: Identify bed bug bites, fecal spotting, cast skins, and harborage hiding spots in coastal vacation rentals, apartments, and private homes.

name: Mosquitoes
description: Explore mosquito breeding dynamics near Bolsa Chica wetlands, Huntington Harbour docks, and residential yard water catchments.

name: Spiders
description: Recognize the spherical spiky egg sacs of brown widows and the glossy black webs of Western black widows nesting around patios and garages.
